name: Collin J. Cox
tagline: Top rated Business Litigation attorney in Houston, Texas
about: Collin J. Cox is an attorney who represents clients in the Houston, Texas area. Collin Cox is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2013 - 2026. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

Collin Cox chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. He attended Duke University School of Law and graduated in 2001. Collin Cox passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 2001.
He represents clients with Business Litigation issues in Texas.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, Collin Cox has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.
